description: T_reject dependence near critical point + recuperator effectiveness at part-load + ambient derating

cycle.name: Recompression sCO2 Brayton — demonstrator class (10 MWe)
cycle.source: Dostal, Driscoll & Hejzlar (2004) MIT-ANP-TR-100; Crespi et al. (2017) Appl. Energy 195, 152-183; Wright et al. (2010) SAND2010-0171; Sarkar & Bhattacharyya (2009) Energy Conv. Manag. 50, 1991-1997.

eta_rated.note: Rated cycle efficiency at design point

a_partload.note: Part-load loss coefficient (sCO2 relatively flat; compressor matching issue at low load)

T_reject_design_c.note: Compressor inlet temperature at design — near critical point (31.1 degC)

k_T_reject.note: Efficiency derating per K above design T_reject (stronger than steam because near critical point)

T_critical_penalty_c.note: Temperature margin above T_crit; within this band penalty is nonlinear

eps_recup_design.note: Recuperator effectiveness at design point (high-effectiveness HTX critical for sCO2)

eps_recup_PLR_slope.note: Recuperator effectiveness drop per unit PLR reduction: eps = eps_design * (1 + slope*(1-PLR))
